name: Juvenescence
note: Drug-development company focused on extending healthspan (SailGP press release, 22 Nov 2024). Its co-founders are Dr. Greg Bailey (Executive Chairman), Jim Mellon (Deputy Chairman) and Dr. Declan Doogan (Board Member) (juvlabs.com/our-team). Dr. Greg Bailey acquired the Canada SailGP Team in 2024, which was renamed NorthStar (SailGP press release, 2 Oct 2024, sailgp.com/news/24/confirmed-canada-sailgp-team-sold-to-new-owners/).
